subject: Pricing packet & usage estimate for LumenPay — checking receipt
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.r@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing packet & usage estimate for LumenPay — follow-up from our demo

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for your time on today's call — I enjoyed learning more about LumenPay's transaction routing and settlement windows. Per our conversation I'm attaching the pricing packet and a preliminary monthly estimate that maps your current traffic to our Dedicated / Hosted options.

High-level summary:
- Estimated monthly tokens: ~120M (after compression/caching)
- Recommended deployment: Dedicated 2xA10 reserved with burst to Hosted for peak ETL jobs
- Monthly estimate (baseline): $18,500 — includes model license, reserved capacity, and 30-day log retention

Attachments:
- Redwood-Pricing-LumenPay-Estimate.pdf (pricing + line-item breakdown)

Next steps
1) Can you confirm receipt of the deck?
2) If it makes sense, I can walk through the numbers in 20 minutes and show how the autoscale/burst works for batch ETL.

Proposed times: Tue 5/11 9:00–9:20 PT or Wed 5/12 11:00–11:20 PT. If those don't work, share some slots and I'll adapt.

If timing has shifted for you or this isn't a priority right now, no problem — say the word and I'll pause follow-ups.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.d@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-LumenPay-Estimate.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

Hi Elena —

Quick nudge on the pricing packet I sent last week. Wanted to make sure it landed and see if a short walkthrough would help clarify the numbers.

I'm available:
- Tue 5/11 9:00–9:20 PT
- Wed 5/12 11:00–11:20 PT

If you've shifted priorities or procurement needs more time, just let me know and I won't follow up again this week.

Thanks,
Priyom
